description: Defines the template class Cell_ECM for modeling a cell with ECM (Electrochemical Model) including state management, parameter initialization, and simulation methods.

classes.name: Cell_ECM
classes.description: Template class modeling a cell with ECM, including state variables, parameters, and methods for simulation and state management.

methods.name: Cell_ECM()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the cell with default parameters and OCV curve.
